newsitem.title: UK: NW Europe oil, gas rigs down in week - Andersen.
newsitem.headline: NW Europe oil, gas rigs down in week - Andersen.

text.p: The number of active oil and gas rigs in operation offshore northwest Europe fell by four to 57 in the week to November 13, consultants Arthur Andersen said on Friday.
There were 29 rigs active in U.K. waters, up one on the week, but Norwegian activity fell by one to 18.
In the Dutch sector, there were eight rigs active, down two on the week, while Danish activity fell one to two rigs. There were no rigs active in Irish waters, down one.
Onshore drilling activity fell one as there was no activity in the Faroe Islands, although U.K. onshore activity was steady at three rigs.
